_meta: Judge 1. Viewed 960px thumbnails and Commons file pages (description, date, categories, coordinates) for all 14 distinct files. scripts/photo-prefilter.ts reads only src/data/imageManifest.json, so it cannot be run on candidates; its checks were done by hand instead: all dated 2006-2026, none in archive/map/drawing/historical categories, all clearly full-colour, widths checked against minimums (header >=2000, why-visit >=1280).

choice_notes.wv2_escarpment_track: Accept, marginal on 'spectacular': overcast flat sky, tiny walkers. It is a genuine photo of the right track (swing bridge, Pukerua Bay headland, sea) and the only file. Reason wording must describe what is shown: the swing bridge and a clifftop path above the sea, with the Pukerua Bay headland. Do not promise sunny sea views, big cliffs, or Kapiti Island views from the track. Wording like 'Cross the swing bridge on the Escarpment Track' fits; 'Spectacular clifftop views' does not.
choice_notes.wv1_wildlife: Takahe, not kiwi: it is a real bird on Kapiti Island (file description and Category 'Takahe on Kapiti Island'). Reason should be about takahe (or 'rare birds'), not kiwi. The kiwi file is rejected because its location is unproven.
choice_notes.header_vs_alt: Header takes the 5449px sunset file; the Waikanae file (2048 px) goes to the beaches slot, so no file is repeated.

candidates.reason: Te Hapua Road beach access, Te Horo, on the Kapiti Coast; Category Kapiti Island; 14 Jul 2024. Colour photo, 5449x3633 (3:2), island centred on the horizon, dune grass in the foreground, dramatic sunset cloud. Island is small but is the subject and sits near centre, so a square crop keeps it. No people or buildings.
As header: 2048 px is barely over the 2000 minimum and the light is muted and flat. Good file, so used for the beaches slot instead.
Phone snapshot from a lawn: a sign board and a tree intrude, only part of the island shows low at the right edge, off-centre. Flat.

candidates.file: Kapiti from Waimeha Domain, Waikanae on 7 July 2024.jpg
candidates.reason: Correct place and a real photo, but the lower two thirds is a dark featureless sand flat at twilight. Too gloomy for a header.

candidates.file: Kapiti Island from the Maungakotukutuku Saddle, New Zealand, 3 November 2006.jpg
candidates.reason: Reject for the header. Wide inland hill view of the island, nice colour, but it shows the hills rather than the coast, and the pylon and shed edge frame is not the beach the destination sells. Better than most as a fallback.

Description 'Takahe (Porphyrio hochstetteri) Kapiti Island, New Zealand'; Category Takahe on Kapiti Island; 29 Dec 2007; 3456x2304 (3:2), colour, sharp, red bill and blue-green plumage against flax. Bird is centre-right and the crop keeps it. Genuine wildlife photograph. Rare-bird 'wow' subject.
Correct place (Kapiti Island, 2010) but near-square, and blades of grass blur across the bird's body. A 1.6:1 crop is acceptable but weaker than Takahe2 and it is the same photographer.

Kapiti Island confirmed by the title, category and description (2014). Square close-up with the bird at the lower left; a 1.6:1 centre crop would cut off the head. Reject on shape (would need PHOTO_FOCUS_Y) and as a tight close-up. Fallback only.

Not shown to be on Kapiti Island. Page has no place name, only iNaturalist coordinates -40.9717, 174.9670, which fall in the sea south of Kapiti Island and are almost certainly obscured (the species is a threatened one). The bird wears a leg band, so it is a managed population that could be Kapiti, Zealandia, or elsewhere. It is also a dim night shot. Cannot confirm place, so it fails.

Categories Escarpment Track, Kapiti Coast, Pukerua Bay; description names the Paekakariki Escarpment track (Te Araroa); 5 Nov 2016; 5760x3840, colour, sharp. Shows the swing bridge on a steep flax hillside above the sea. Marginal: overcast and muted, but the bridge, slope and coast are all clear and nothing else exists. Wording note in choice_notes.

Categories Kapiti Island, Waikanae, Vegetated dunes; 2006 500px import, 2048x1362 (3:2), colour, clean, no people. Dune grass, a driftwood log and the whole island across blue water: the clearest 'beach facing the island' shot. Accepted at 2048 px, over the 1280 minimum. Not used for the header, so no repeat.

candidates.file: Kapiti Island and driftwood on Otaki Beach (7087598167).jpg
candidates.reason: Otaki Beach (category) but the subject is the driftwood stump, the island is a small grey blob and a walker is in frame; the uploader says they did not reach the island. Overcast and dull.

candidates.file: Beach at Queen Elizabeth Park, Kāpiti Coast 01.jpg
candidates.reason: Correct place and colour photo, but a pale washed-out sky, the beach is a thin strip behind scrub and a path, the island is small. Good fallback, but weaker than the Waikanae shot.
Otaki Beach with island, 2008, colour. Heavy purple fringe or banding at the top edge and an unfocused plain foreground; island tiny. Looks processed, not the best.
Tractor, traffic cones and benches fill the foreground, a person sits at the rail. Beach itself is barely seen. Not wanted.
